name: m3-keyboard-annotate-light
steps: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.an-keys button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Add box in center');if(!b)throw Error('No Add box in center key');b.click()})()
(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.an-keys button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Add pin in center');if(!b)throw Error('No Add pin in center key');b.click()})()

if(!window.__sim.host.journal.some(e=>e.event.type==='timeline_appended'&&e.event.item.item.kind==='user_message'&&e.event.item.item.bundle?.marks.length===2)) throw Error('Annotated message was not admitted')
if(document.querySelector('.an-screen:not(.is-hidden *)')&&document.querySelector('.route:not(.is-hidden) .an-screen')) throw Error('Still in the annotation editor after sending')
